cards.intuition: A publisher offers a candidate URL inventory, including orphan pages that links may miss. Entries remain hints requiring validation and scope checks.
RSS and Atom are recent-item windows, strong for incremental freshness but weak as complete history if polling has gaps.
cards.formula: poll conditionally + deduplicate by stable entry ID or canonical URL

cards.intuition: Push reduces lag but messages can repeat and reorder. Stable event IDs and source versions make application idempotent and monotonic.
cards.formula: apply event only when version > stored version

cards.intuition: Use notifications for speed, feeds for recent repair, and inventory diffs for broad reconciliation. Provenance explains disagreements.

cards.concept: Search API as discovery, not inventory
cards.intuition: The provider returns a capped ranked sample shaped by query and index policy. Diversify queries and measure unique in-scope yield.
cards.formula: value = new eligible canonical URLs / API requests
cards.topic: Search APIs as an Acquisition Channel

cards.intuition: Keep provider, query, rank, cursor, time, and result ID even after URL deduplication so discovery remains explainable.
cards.topic: Search APIs as an Acquisition Channel

cards.intuition: A snippet is a query-biased preview, not a complete authoritative document. Fetch permitted source content or preserve licensed full results.
cards.formula: snippet for triage; source document for corpus truth
cards.topic: Search APIs as an Acquisition Channel

cards.intuition: Choose starting points that reach different desired regions, not many entrances to the same popular pages.
cards.formula: seed value = marginal canonical coverage under fixed budget
cards.topic: Seed Selection and Crawl Scope Policy

cards.intuition: Hosts alone are insufficient. Control paths, scheme, ports, parameters, types, languages, dates, size, depth, and authorization.
cards.formula: normalized URL + resolved destination + policy → allow or reject
cards.topic: Seed Selection and Crawl Scope Policy

cards.intuition: An approved URL can redirect elsewhere, and DNS can resolve to private infrastructure. Revalidate every destination and resolved address.
cards.formula: check before frontier and after every redirect
cards.topic: Seed Selection and Crawl Scope Policy

cards.intuition: A large fetched count proves volume, not completeness. Compare against inventories or gold pages and stratify missing regions.
cards.formula: coverage = acquired eligible resources / known eligible resources
cards.topic: Seed Selection and Crawl Scope Policy
